title: Tensor counit square for the ordered affine tower
statement: Let A be finite commutative, N annihilate A, and S be Noetherian with N invertible. For normalized transport t and projective-line data D on every Noetherian intermediate scheme [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-data], the actual ordered affine adjunction counit [def-amb-affine-trace-construction] commutes with action and strength [def-pur-ordinary-affine-tensor-actions] at every dimension d and every pair H,K of arbitrary unbounded input complexes.

source.place: last paragraph: projection formula on chosen compactifications and the ordered affine-line tower; categorical calculations making coefficient normalization explicit

proof.text:
apply counitTensor_tower with coefficient endofunctor tensoring on the left
by the ordered pullback of H. At coordinate e, ordinaryAffineLine_tensorCounit is
exactly the required one-step square. The tower definitions give the pasted action
and strength. No equation asserting determination of a map by its unit value is used.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryAffineTower_tensorCounit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t T hT)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ) (H K : DerivedCategoryModule A S) :
    (action A S H d).app ((affineTraceRight A N hA S d).obj K) ≫
      (affineTraceLeft A S d).map (strength A N hA S H d K).hom ≫
      (affineTraceAdjunction A N hA t D S hS d).counit.app
        (((ordinaryFiniteTensor A S).obj H).obj K) =
      ((ordinaryFiniteTensor A S).obj H).map
        ((affineTraceAdjunction A N hA t D S hS d).counit.app K)
